view.emptyEnvironment: No services in this environment yet
view.emptyEnvironmentHint: Add a GitHub repository, a Docker image, or a database.
view.lanTitle: Resolves only on your local network
view.removeHosted: The database and its user are dropped from the instance hosting them. The instance itself is untouched.
view.removeHost: The container goes, and with it the {count, plural, one {# database} other {# databases}} hosted inside it. The named volume holding the data is left on the server so it can still be recovered by hand.
view.removeContainer: The container goes; the named volume holding its data is left on the server so it can still be recovered by hand.

connection.unreadable: Could not read the connection details
connection.referenceHint: Paste into a service's variable. It resolves to this database's address on every deploy, and to the copy's database in a copied environment.
connection.uriCluster: One node of the cluster, reachable by name from any service in this environment.
connection.uriMembers: Lists all {count} members, so a client finds the primary wherever it is.
connection.uriHint: Reachable by name from any service in this environment.
connection.nodesHint: A Redis cluster of {masters} masters and {masters} replicas. Connect with a client in cluster mode and give it these nodes; it is sent to the right one for each key.
connection.nodesReferenceHint: Resolves to the list above, for a client that takes every node.
connection.readUriHint: Reads only, spread over the replicas. As a reference: {reference}
connection.exposed: Also published on the server at port {port}

view.serverHint: Where this service runs. Connect more under Servers.
view.name: Name

template.createsDatabase: Creates a {engine} database beside it too, named after the service. Its variables point at the database, so no password is copied.
template.createsCompanion: Creates a second service beside it for the {companion}, reachable only from this environment.
template.secrets: Generated secrets are in the service's Variables.
template.setup: Setup runs inside it once it is up, and the service says how it went.

image.label: Image
image.hint: Docker Hub, GHCR, Quay, GitLab or MCR. Private images: add a login under Registries.
image.portHint: The port the container listens on. Leave empty to detect it from the image; set it (e.g. 5601 for OpenSearch Dashboards) only if the image exposes several ports or none.

github.publicOnly: Searching public repositories. <link>Connect your GitHub account</link> to reach private ones and your own list.
github.noDockerfile: No Dockerfile found - Nixpacks auto-builds from the source.
github.rootDirectoryHint: For a repository holding several apps. The build still gets the whole repository, so shared packages and the lockfile above it are available.

database.privilegeOwner: Owner - full control of this database
database.privilegeReadWrite: Read and write - no schema changes
database.redisSingleHint: One Redis, reached at one address.
database.redisClusterHint: Keys are spread over {masters} masters on this server, each with a replica that takes over if it stops. Clients connect in cluster mode.
database.runsOnShared: Created inside an instance that is already running, sharing its memory and its server.
database.runsOnOwn: Starts a container of its own, with its own data volume.
database.publishedPortSharded: Publishes the cluster's router. Blank keeps it reachable only by the services in this environment.
database.publishedPortHint: Blank keeps it reachable only by the services in this environment, which is what most databases want.
database.privilegesHint: What this user may do inside its own database.
database.passwordHint: Blank generates a strong one and stores it encrypted.

autoDeployDialog.title: Auto-deploy - {name}
autoDeployDialog.onPushHint: Rebuild and deploy automatically when a matching commit is pushed. Needs GitHub App webhooks reaching this instance (public domain).
autoDeployDialog.branchHint: Only this branch triggers a deploy. Blank uses the app's branch.
autoDeployDialog.commitFilterHint: Deploy only when the commit message contains this (e.g. "build:"), or "{pattern}". Blank = any commit.
autoDeployDialog.watchPathsHint: One glob per line. Deploy only when the push touched one of them, so a repository holding several services rebuilds just the ones that changed. Prefix with ! to exclude. Blank = any change.

domainDialog.title: Domains - {name}
domainDialog.customHint: Leave blank for a free subdomain.

variables.none: There are no variables to carry across.
variables.stay: {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} stay where they are: copying them is not part of your access here.
variables.travel: {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} can travel.
variables.travelListed: {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} can travel: {names}.
variables.travelListedMore: {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} can travel: {names}, and more.

out.copied: {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} copied across.
out.domainsStay: {domains} still points at this server - repoint it at {provider} when you are ready.
out.title: Move {name} to Vercel or Railway
out.description: The provider builds and serves it from then on. Polaris keeps it on this project's board and can release it again.
out.doneHint: Everything it had here is exactly where it was: its variables, its history and its containers. Starting it again is one button on its own screen.
out.builtFrom: Built from {repo}. The provider builds it from the same repository, so connect it there first if you have not.
out.builtFromBranch: Built from {repo} on {branch}. The provider builds it from the same repository, so connect it there first if you have not.
out.noRepo: This service is not built from a repository, so there is nothing for a provider to build. Point the provider's project at the code first.
out.volumes: Its volumes stay here and are not copied: {volumes}. A provider that builds from a repository has nowhere to put them.
out.domains: {domains} points at this server and will go on pointing at it. Moving a name is a DNS record at whoever holds it.
out.noAccount: No Vercel or Railway account is linked to your profile yet. Connect one under Connected accounts and it will be offered here.
out.noProjects: That account has no projects Polaris can see. Make the project there first, connected to the same repository.
out.noServices: That project has no services yet.
out.copyVariablesHint: Anything of the same name there is replaced. Nothing else it has is touched.
out.buildNow: Ask them to build it now
out.buildNowHint: A project that has never built there has nothing to repeat yet; push to it instead.
out.stopHereHint: The container comes down. Nothing is deleted, and one button starts it again.

home.created: It is created and ready to deploy.
home.copied: {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} came with it.
home.title: Run {name} on a Polaris server
home.description: Polaris builds it from the same repository and runs it on one of your servers. The project at {provider} is left exactly as it is.
home.doneHint: {name} is still running at {provider} and still on this board. Turn it off there once this one is answering.
home.noSource: {provider} does not say which repository it builds, so Polaris needs the address below.
home.domains: Whatever domain it answers on there keeps answering there. Pointing a name at this server is a DNS record and a domain on the service once it is up.
home.noServer: There is no server to run it on yet. Add one under Servers.
home.copyVariablesHint: Stored as secrets here, except the prefixes that mean a value is compiled into the browser bundle.
home.buildNowHint: Otherwise it is created and waits for you to press Deploy.
home.setByHand: Anything that could not be read has to be set by hand on the service's Variables tab.
